rect.title: Kitchen and dining are completely open to each other.; Combined kitchen/dining length from the Bedroom 2 entrance to the dining end wall is remeasured at 8.12m.; Combined space is close to the deck/patio.
Connects to kitchen/dining through a large opening.; Connects to sunroom through large sliding/glass doors.

polygon.title: Irregular glazed enclosure.; Hand sketch gives internal segment measurements: 5.0m top run, 4.14m right side, 1.55m bottom run, 0.71m lower vertical return, 1.86m diagonal, 1.20m inset horizontal, and 2.15m left side.; Later direct span checks measure 5.02m from the Hallway/Sunroom inside edge to the inside of the sunroom NW window and 4.07m from the Lounge/Sunroom inside edge to the inside of the sunroom west window.; Angled exterior/front door is important and still approximate.

rect.title: Runs from kitchen area to master bedroom end.; Office and bathroom are off the SE side; lounge opening is on the NW side.

Street-facing exterior width measured at approximately 4.77m.; Window facing SW out to road and another window facing NW into sunroom.; Wardrobe side is NE.; Built-in wardrobe depth is 0.62m as a bay between the master bedroom and office; previous master bedroom internal measurements are treated as clear floor area and are not reduced by the wardrobe.
Off hallway.; Window side/facing is SE.
Off hallway and next to Bedroom 2.; Window side/facing is SE.; Shower is 0.88m x 0.74m; bath is 1.74m x 0.73m.
Longer, narrower room; dimensions must not be swapped.; Window side/facing is SE toward neighbours' fence.; Door connects to kitchen on NW side.

Entrance connects off the deck/patio side.; Narrower at the kitchen end, approximately 0.89m wide, then widens by about 0.25m to the 1.16m entrance depth.; Sliding door width is remeasured at 1.47m and starts 0.28m from the inside wall corner where the entrance narrows.; Measured entrance chain is 2.52m from the entrance/laundry opening line to the narrowing point, then 1.13m back to the inside of the kitchen door frame.

At end of house near Bedroom 2 and toilet.; Two windows: the north/deck-side window is 1.38m wide and 0.22m from the top-right/north corner; the east/right-side window is 1.10m wide and 0.95m from the same corner.; Open connection to entrance is 0.74m wide and centred within the 1.16m entrance depth.; Laundry connects to the toilet through a 120mm internal partition.

Connects from laundry.; Toilet clear internal depth in the laundry/toilet stack is 0.91m.; Toilet/laundry clear internal width is 1.80m.; Toilet bottom exterior wall is remeasured as 270mm.; Frosted toilet window is 0.52m wide and centred.

svg.text: Room dimensions are measured; drawn positions are inferred.
